IRON YARD — PUBLIC release fix after v8 blocked CI (11 November 2026)

Owner has requested continuing and publishing changes to the existing
PUBLIC IRON YARD Roblox FPS.

This commit corrects an obsolete CI contract from the previous release:
the local muzzle effect now follows the final first-person viewmodel
render instead of firing directly from the input callback. The contract
verifies final CFrame ordering and stale-effect suppression while keeping
the remote fire checks intact. It includes all v7/v8 game improvements
on main and requires successful exact-SHA Rojo CI before release.

Existing PUBLIC place, owner, source-commit and asset checks are unchanged.
No secret, destination ID, or user credential is stored here.
